{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the column names
column_names = sales_df.columns

# Check the unique values in the 'campaign' column
campaign_unique = sales_df['campaign'].unique()

converted_unique = sales_df['converted'].unique()

# Check the distribution of the 'campaign' column
campaign_counts = sales_df['campaign'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the 'converted' column
converted_counts = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the number of customers who converted in each campaign
conversion_by_campaign = sales_df.groupby('campaign')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the overall conversion rate
overall_conversion_rate = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Compute the conversion rate for each campaign
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('campaign')['converted'].mean()

# Output the results
